sources.snippet: Q: How does this model compare to ms-marco-MiniLM-L12-v2 for my ranking pipeline? A: The L12 model is marginally more accurate (39.02 vs 39.01 MRR@10, nearly identical) but runs at half the speed (960 vs 1800 docs/sec). Use the L6 variant unless you have excess GPU capacity or need to squeeze out the final 0.01 MRR points.
